CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Rtn_Contents_Delete_IM] @T_ID int AS DECLARE @Rtn_Type_ID INT, @IM_ID int, @ST_ID INT, @Valid_ST NVARCHAR(50), @ST_QTY NUMERIC(18,3)
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
DECLARE @Bill_T_ID INT
SELECT @Rtn_Type_ID = Rtn_Type_ID , @IM_ID = IM_ID , @ST_ID = ST_ID , @Valid_ST = D_Vaild , @ST_QTY = ST_QTY , @Bill_T_ID = Bill_T_ID FROM Rtn_Contents where T_ID = @T_ID
DELETE FROM Rtn_Contents where T_ID = @T_ID
--IF @Rtn_Type_ID = 7 BEGIN EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@Valid_ST,@ST_QTY END --else IF @Rtn_Type_ID = 1 BEGIN EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@Valid_ST,@ST_QTY END
EXEC [Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total] @Bill_T_ID
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 raiserror('[Rtn_Contents_Delete_IM]',16,1,'خطأ') ROLLBACK END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SB_Contents_Change_IM_Qty] @T_ID int, @Def int, @On_Update Bit AS
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
DECLARE @U_Cargo NUMERIC(18,2),@IM_ID INT,@ST_ID INT,@D_Vaild NVARCHAR(50),@ST_QTY NUMERIC(18,3),@SB_T_ID INT,@AG_ID INT , @Cur_QTY FLOAT
SELECT @U_Cargo = U_Cargo ,@IM_ID=IM_ID, @ST_ID=ST_ID,@D_Vaild=D_Vaild ,@SB_T_ID = Bill_T_ID ,@Cur_QTY = QTY FROM SB_Contents where T_ID = @T_ID
IF (@Cur_QTY + @Def) >= 1 BEGIN UPDATE SB_Contents SET QTY = QTY + @Def , T_Price = (Price * (QTY + @Def)) , ST_QTY = (QTY + @Def) * U_Cargo where T_ID = @T_ID END
IF @On_Update = 1 BEGIN EXEC AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update @SB_T_ID,1 END
IF (SELECT ISNULL(S_Bills_Type,1) FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @SB_T_ID) <> 3 -- SURE That the bill is not order BEGIN
IF @On_Update = 1 BEGIN EXEC [SB_Contents_Structers_Recount_One] @T_ID END
IF @Def = 1 BEGIN EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Vaild,@U_Cargo END ELSE BEGIN EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Vaild,@U_Cargo END
END
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 raiserror('[SB_Contents_Change_IM_Qty]',16,1,'خطأ') ROLLBACK END CATCH
